Devon R: Postmortem follow-up: vendor auth outages caused model-registry write failures. Need owners, short+long term fixes, and recurring drill schedule.
Leah S: I'll own the short term token-caching + retry backoff. POC 48h, canary 5 days.
Omar H: I'll take long-term dual-provider auth and SLA negotiation. Draft due in 10 days.
InfraBot: Note: attach incident logs to epic when created.
Tess M: Create a single epic INF-7950 and link tasks. Add acceptance criteria: on 401 spike, switch to cached-mode <30s.
Leah S: POC details: small Redis KV, key=svc|scope, TTL=4m, refresh jitter, singleflight refresh to avoid thundering herd, metrics token_cache_hit, token_refresh_failures.
Omar H: Also propose write-queue for model-registry writes during auth outage; idempotent replay. Priors: S3-backed queue prototype in 4 days.
Devon R: Ops runbook updates: flip feature-flag auth:cached-mode, enable write-queue, notify vendor. Add logging: vendor-response-code + region.
Tess M: INF-7950 created with INF-7951(token cache), INF-7952(write-queue), INF-7953(dual-auth). Weekly check-ins scheduled.
Leah S: Will post daily progress here until canary healthy.
InfraBot: Canary deploy scheduled: 2026-09-08T01:00Z.
Devon R: Thanks all. Reconvene in 7 days. If tasks slip, update the epic and ping @Devon R. :thumbsup:
